question: Does moving the equity exposure by the sealed market-state machine add value AT MATCHED AVERAGE EXPOSURE (TIMING > 0), net of the cost of the moves, against holding the regional ETF?
notTheQuestion: drawdown reduction against the ETF (that is effect A, achievable by a lower constant exposure)
re-fitting any window, threshold, lag, level or mapping on history

KR.etfReturnBasis: TOTAL_RETURN (repository's reconciled 069500.KS series; same vendor at scoring)

cash.rule: a TIMING claim must hold in sign under both cash readings

stateInputs.FAST: FDR_KS200 close (already recorded weekly by rp1-b-h1-state-v1 state.fast)
stateInputs.SLOW: FRED DGS10 - DGS3MO re-steepening flag, month-end, FRED lag 4d
stateInputs.TRANSITION: FRED VIXCLS level vs its own past weekly history (top fifth, min 156 obs)

US.etfReturnBasis: TOTAL_RETURN (economic reading of the US replication)
US.stateMachine: pipeline/rp1_c1_us_exposure.py layer_states/decision_schedule with market='US' (sealed KR rules, US calendar)

cash.rule: a TIMING claim must hold in sign under both cash readings

stateInputs.FAST: S&P 500 price index close (FRED SP500 / ^GSPC per the US spec registry)
stateInputs.SLOW: same FRED spread rule as KR

candidates.missingState: sealed rule: a multiplier is defined only when every completion of the missing layers agrees; otherwise hold the previous target (counted)

recording.cadence: weekly: KR decision = KR week-end session close (prospective_receipt_core.is_weekly_decision_session); US decision = US week-end session close (rp1_c1_us_exposure.period_end_sessions(market='US'))
recording.execution: next session close of the same market
receiptFields: layer states (SLOW, TRANSITION, FAST) or None with reason
every candidate's multiplier and hold flag
createdAtUtc inside the window (after signal close, before next open)
recording.ledger: append-only JSONL with digest chain (prospective_receipt_core); one ledger per region; never backfilled

decomposition.period: one weekly execution-to-execution interval; x_t = the candidate target executed at the start of the period
decomposition.identity: mean(R_overlay - R_E) = LEVEL + TIMING; LEVEL = (xbar - 1) mean(R_E - R_F); TIMING = mean((x - xbar)(R_E - R_F))
decomposition.staticControl: constant exposure xbar of the SAME window (exposure-matched); TIMING = mean(R_overlay - R_static)
decomposition.costTerm: stress x (buy x increase + sell x decrease) of exposure, build uncharged; TIMING_NET = TIMING - mean(COST)
decomposition.driftResidual: realised drifting-path return minus the per-period model return is reported as a residual, never folded into TIMING

windows.H126: weekly periods whose execution session lies within the first 126 sessions after the cohort's execution

horizons.cohort: every weekly receipt starts a cohort; within each cohort window TIMING_t^h and its own xbar_t^h are computed
horizons.primaryStatistic: mean over matured cohorts of TIMING_NET_t^H252 at cost stress 1x

inference.method: Newey-West (Bartlett) HAC on the cohort series; lag in weekly observations = ceil(h / 5) sessions-per-week overlap
inference.multiplicity: Holm, one-sided alpha 0.05 over the four primary claims; H126 claims are secondary and descriptive
inference.calibrationPrerequisite: the rp1-inference-calibration cells (KR/US H252) calibrate a different, cross-sectional statistic; a calibration cell for THIS time-series statistic at the realised depth must be registered before the first confirmatory read, otherwise every read is DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY
inference.costRule: a claim needs the Holm-adjusted lower bound > 0 at 1x AND a positive point estimate at 2x; 3x is reported

minimumAccrual.basis: weekly receipts; H252 cohorts first mature about 52 weeks after the first receipt
minimumAccrual.H252: no read before 6 NON-OVERLAPPING matured H252 windows per region (about 6 years of receipts + 252 sessions)
minimumAccrual.H126: no read before 6 non-overlapping matured H126 windows per region (about 3 years + 126 sessions)
minimumAccrual.exposureVariation: at least 4 exposure changes inside the read window; otherwise NO_DYNAMIC_EXPOSURE_OBSERVED (not a fail)
minimumAccrual.interimPublication: state counts, exposure-change counts and receipt integrity only; no return-based number before the minimum

classification.B_TIMING_SUPPORTED: Holm lower bound of TIMING_NET > 0 at 1x, positive at 2x, same sign under both cash readings
classification.A_ONLY_LEVEL_RISK_REDUCTION: overlay drawdown shallower than ETF but NOT shallower than the exposure-matched static control, and TIMING interval contains zero
classification.RECEIPT_INTEGRITY_FAILED: missed weekly receipts > 10% of due sessions, a backfilled or rewritten row, or a broken chain

failureRules: no threshold, window, lag, level, mapping or candidate is re-optimised on history or on receipts
a missed week is MISSED, never backfilled; a region whose missed share exceeds 10% cannot claim
historical development numbers (KR 2007-2026, US 1993-2026) are never pooled with receipts
C2/C3 are recorded but cannot be promoted into the primary family after the fact
an unfavourable read closes this contract version; a successor is a new id with its own registration
productionEffect: NONE: the operating default stays 100% regional ETF; no read authorizes an exposure change
prerequisites: KR: a writer for SLOW/TRANSITION + all candidate multipliers (pipeline/kr_market_risk_model_receipts.py has the contract, no writer)
US: a state recorder and ledger (none exists)
owner registration of this contract (spec + code hash) before the first counted receipt; receipts before registration do not count
a calibration cell for the time-series TIMING statistic (see inference)
